comment: The three attenuators each span 0 to 0.2 and are multiplied by the full parameter range (Vibrato.cpp:96 to :98), which is why 5V covers the whole range at maximum in all three cases. The delay is read from a 16384-sample ring buffer with third-order B-spline interpolation (Vibrato.cpp:174 to :178) and the tap runs from 4 samples to twice the depth plus 4 (Vibrato.cpp:145). The output is the delayed sample plus the input times the flanger amount, with no feedback (Vibrato.cpp:180).
